name: More than 100%
rule: 100% is the whole. 200% is double, 300% is triple. For something like 150%, take the whole and add the extra: 100% + 50%.
why: Percents over 100 just mean more than the whole. The answer is always bigger than the number you started with.

clues: Is this percent more or less than 100%? So will the answer be bigger or smaller than {n}?
100% of {n} is {n}. Now find the extra {over}%.
The extra {over}% of {n} is {extra}. Add it to {n}.
